title: Forensic Agent Event
description: A single chain entry in an AI Forensics Audit Trail. See SPEC-v1.0.md §4 for normative semantics.

id.description: Global monotonic sequence number per operator. Used by the attestation's audit_log_ids array.

agent_id.description: The acting agent identity. Stable across rotations of the agent's credentials.

agent_name.description: Human-readable agent label at capture time. May diverge from the current agent record (renames, deletes).

user_id.description: Initiating principal, if applicable. Null for service-to-service or fully autonomous flows.

correlation_id.description: Cross-system trace correlator. SHOULD match the OpenTelemetry trace ID when available.

endpoint.description: Upstream URL the agent called. Operators MUST scrub credentials from query strings before persistence.

decision.description: Gateway decision at policy-evaluation time. 'error' is reserved for gateway-side failures (not upstream 5xx, which are 'allow' with response metadata).

cost_estimate_usd.description: Inferred or reported cost of the call. Decimal precision should be at least 1e-6 USD.

latency_ms.description: End-to-end latency as observed by the gateway.

request_metadata.description: Provider-specific structured metadata. MUST NOT contain raw secrets or PII payloads.

system_fingerprint.description: Provider system fingerprint, if exposed. Anchors the response to a specific provider deployment.

provider_response_id.description: Provider-assigned response ID. Used as integrity anchor when logprobs are unavailable (see SPEC §9.1).

policy_version.description: The version of the operator's policy ruleset that evaluated this request.

atlas_tags.description: MITRE ATLAS technique IDs triggered or relevant to this event (e.g., ['T0051', 'T0040']).

otel_trace_id.description: Hex-encoded W3C Trace Context trace ID. SHOULD match correlation_id when both are present.

otel_span_id.description: Hex-encoded W3C Trace Context span ID for this event.

entry_hash.description: HMAC-SHA256 over RFC 8785 canonical JSON of all other fields plus prev_hash. See SPEC §4.1.

prev_hash.description: entry_hash of the previous chain entry. First entry uses 64 hex zeros as the seed.

prev_hash_org.description: Optional per-org chain linkage. See SPEC §4.2.

entry_hash_org.description: Optional per-org chain hash. See SPEC §4.2.

org_chain_seq.description: Per-org monotonic sequence number. Present iff per-org chain is in use.

created_at.description: Capture time as observed by the gateway, RFC 3339 with explicit UTC offset.
